card_text: [On Play] If your Leader's type includes "GERMA", look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 card with a type including "GERMA" and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
sub_types: The Vinsmoke Family Kingdom of GERMA
